Best for: No Credit Needed

Initial Payment: $49 + tax

Term: 12 months

How It Works: Standard agreement offers 12 months to ownership. 90-day and other early purchase options cost more than the retailer’s cash price (except 3-month option in CA). To purchase early, or to cancel lease and schedule return of merchandise, you must call 877-898-1970. Retailer cannot activate early purchase options.

Ownership by rental/lease agreement with Progressive Leasing costs more than the retailer’s cash price. Select items only. At anytime, you may purchase early or return merchandise and cancel lease. Not available in MN, NJ, WI.

No Credit Needed: Progressive Leasing obtains information from credit bureaus, but a credit history is not required. Not all applicants are approved.

The initial payment (plus tax) is charged at lease signing. Remaining lease payments will be calculated upon item selection.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do I need a credit check to qualify?›
Progressive, Acima, and Koalifi do not require a credit history to apply. Progressive Leasing obtains information from credit bureaus, but a credit history is not required — not all applicants are approved. Synchrony requires a standard credit check.
How do I apply?›
You can apply online or in-store. Most approvals come back in seconds. Just pick the provider you want, fill out a short application, and you will know your approval amount right away.
What about early purchase options?›
All lease-to-own providers offer early purchase options. Progressive offers a 90-day option, Acima offers 90 days, and Koalifi offers 100 days. Purchasing early reduces your total cost. Lease-to-own costs more than the retailer’s cash price.
Will this affect my credit?›
Progressive and Acima do not report to credit bureaus. Koalifi reports to TransUnion, which can help build your credit with on-time payments. Synchrony reports to all major bureaus.
What do I need to apply?›
A valid ID, a checking account at a traditional bank with direct deposits, and your Social Security number. Synchrony requires a standard credit application.
Can I use lease-to-own on any product?›
Select items are available for lease-to-own. Financing is available on most items we carry — sectionals, sofas, mattresses, bedroom sets, dining, outdoor, and more.
